summary: The filing reports consummation of a private placement by CL Workshop Group Limited, a BVI-incorporated foreign private issuer listed on Nasdaq, under Form 6-K. On August 7, 2026, the Company sold 12,300,000 units at US$0.20 each, each comprising one ADS representing eight Class A ordinary shares and a warrant to purchase three ADSs at US$0.25, exercisable upon registration effectiveness and expiring one year later. Gross proceeds were approximately US$2.46 million, with potential additional US$9.23 million from warrant exercise. The Company relied on BVI home country practices to avoid Nasdaq shareholder approval rules. Proceeds are for working capital. This is a capital-raising event, not a conventional special situation; classify as Other with medium confidence.
